description: Regression tests after Phase 3 bug fixes for ouroboros, rustoshi, haskoin, beamchain

corrupt_merkle.rejection: Block validation failed: Merkle root mismatch

corrupt_nonce.rejection: Block validation failed: Coinbase height mismatch

corrupt_nonce.detail: Block with corrupted nonce still had valid PoW on regtest (target=0x7fffff...). The real bug is that ouroboros treated a block with prevhash pointing to height 19 as block 21 instead of a competing block at height 20. Core correctly rejects this scenario.

bugs_found.description: ouroboros: does not validate that submitted block's prevhash matches the actual chain tip. A block with prevhash pointing to height 19 was accepted as height 21 (should have been rejected or treated as a competing block at height 20).
bugs_found.detail: Corrupted nonce block had valid PoW on regtest but same prevhash as block 20. Core correctly returns 'inconclusive' and stays at height 20. Ouroboros incorrectly advanced to height 21.

bugs_found.description: rustoshi: getblockhash RPC returns 'Block height N out of range' for heights 1-20 even though blocks were accepted via submitblock and chain tip matches Core at height 20. The height-to-hash index may not be populated during submitblock processing.

rustoshi_submitblock_stub.original_bug: submitblock RPC was a stub that accepted blocks but didn't process them
rustoshi_submitblock_stub.evidence: All 20 blocks accepted, chain tip matches Core at height 20
rustoshi_submitblock_stub.remaining_issue: getblockhash height index not populated (moderate severity)

haskoin_bip34_height_parsing.original_bug: BIP-34 coinbase height parsing rejected blocks with OP_1..OP_16 height encoding
haskoin_bip34_height_parsing.evidence: All 20 blocks (heights 1-16 use OP_1..OP_16, 17-20 use CScriptNum) accepted without error

beamchain_regtest_startup.original_bug: Release build (escript) fails to find liberocksdb NIF on startup
beamchain_regtest_startup.evidence: Escript build still fails with 'failed_to_find_liberocksdb'. Workaround: use 'rebar3 shell' with BEAMCHAIN_NETWORK=regtest env var. Once running, all 20 blocks accepted and chain tip matches.
beamchain_regtest_startup.note: Escript needs NIF path fix; rebar3 shell works as workaround

ouroboros_merkle_root_validation.evidence: Block with corrupted merkle root correctly rejected with detailed error message
ouroboros_merkle_root_validation.new_bug: prevhash validation missing - accepts blocks whose prevhash doesn't match chain tip as new blocks at wrong height
